title: Bus Queue Sort
description: Clear gridlocked parking lanes and dispatch color-coded buses to pick up matching waiting passengers before every boarding bay fills up.
controls: Tap unblocked colored buses in the lot to send them to the pickup lane so matching passengers can board and depart.

zh-CN.title: 排队上车
zh-CN.description: 抖音爆款颜色配对挪车接人：按队列乘客颜色依次调度对应颜色小巴驶出停车场，清空全部乘客爽感拉满！
zh-CN.controls: 点击前方无遮挡的彩色大巴驶入候车位，接走对应颜色排队乘客即可发车清场。
